thread:
evan: Short update 1 — were starting a staged rollout of the Hosted API Stream Adapter + ToolCall v3 tomorrow. First 48h opt-in window then evaluate metrics for wider enablement. :megaphone:

leila: Quick Q: will GDPR/data residency customers be impacted? Any policy changes?

legal: No policy changes. For Private deployments customers must coordinate with their account engineer to enable adapter locally. Hosted customers in EU regions remain under same data residency controls.

caroline: Performance snapshot from canary: p50 down ~15ms, p95 down ~6%, and observed fewer small-frame retries due to coalescing. Tool-heavy tests saw a 7% token reduction on average.

ops-bot: Canary rollout: stream-adapter@v1.2 -> canary-sets in us-west, eu-central. Alerts: none above baseline.

ev an: Can we get a snippet we can share with early access customers?

docs-team: Yep. Internal quick sample: 
```bash
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -H "X-RW-Tool-Version: 3" 
  -d '{"model":"mosaic-lite","stream":true,"input":"analyze:..."}' 
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream-adapter
```

sales-lead: Putting together a short customer note: highlight no price changes, improved latency/cost for tool flows, and optional header to opt-in. Also share CS playbook.

leila: Deprecation plan for v1/v2?

ev an: Well keep v1/v2 for 9 months. At month 6 we start in-console nudges and SDK warnings; formal deprecation notice at month 8.

caroline: Action items: 1) docs publish (docs-team) 2) EA customer email (sales-lead) 3) SDK patches (node/python today; other langs next week) 4) extend canary if any regressions (ops).

legal: One note 1: update our public API terms to reference the new adapter in the Integrations section. Ill drop a PR.

ev an: Thanks all. If anyone sees anomalies post-rollout paste request ids and tag @ops. Otherwise timeline is opt-in -> 48h -> flip default -> monitor 72h -> GA announcement. :rocket:
